Hioki ST5520-01 Description 
You can easily test insulation resistance and withstand voltage in electrical devices and components with this Hioki ST5520-01 Insulation Tester with BCD Output. Great for battery production lines, the tester quickly produces results in as little as 50 ms. Use the Contact Check function to ensure proper contact is made prior to running the test.
Features
Use to measure insulation resistance and withstand voltage in electrical devices and components
Delivers findings in as little as 50 ms with a 25 to 1,000 V test voltage at 1 V resolution
Contact Check function checks if proper contact is made with the device before testing
Short-Circuit Check function applies low voltage (2 to 4 VDC) to the test patterns in order to check for micro-shorting before insulation testing
Quickly discharges residual voltage
Description Upper_Fail, Pass and Lower_Fail comparison settings with audible sounds to notify you of the results
